abstract_sentences.text: Most LLM fingerprinting methods teach the model to respond to a few fixed queries with predefined atypical responses (keys).

evidence.anchor: fixed queries with predefined atypical responses

abstract_sentences.text: This memorization often does not survive common deployment steps such as finetuning or quantization, and such keys can be easily detected and filtered from LLM responses, ultimately breaking the fingerprint.

evidence.anchor: does not survive common deployment steps

abstract_sentences.text: To overcome these limitations we introduce LLM fingerprinting via semantically conditioned watermarks, replacing fixed query sets with a broad semantic domain, and replacing brittle atypical keys with a statistical watermarking signal diffused throughout each response.

evidence.anchor: replacing fixed query sets with a broad semantic domain

abstract_sentences.text: After teaching the model to watermark its responses only to prompts from a predetermined domain, e.g., French language, the model owner can use queries from that domain to reliably detect the fingerprint and verify ownership.

evidence.anchor: reliably detect the fingerprint and verify ownership

abstract_sentences.text: As we confirm in our thorough experimental evaluation, our fingerprint is both stealthy and robust to all common deployment scenarios.

evidence.anchor: both stealthy and robust to all common deployment scenarios

introduction_moves.move: context：以训练成本、restrictive license 和第三方 API 部署建立 model ownership proof 的实际需求；下一段转向 black-box fingerprint。
problem：说明 query-key black-box fingerprint 依赖少量固定 query 与 atypical key，检测需要精确回复；留下 stealth 与 robustness 的双重问题。

evidence.anchor: existing fingerprints are neither robust nor stealthy

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work：具体说明 pseudorandom query/key 易被过滤，输入或输出的轻微变化也会使 exact-match fingerprint 失效；为替代范式制造缺口。

evidence.anchor: easy for the malicious deployer to detect and block

introduction_moves.move: core_idea：以 broad semantic domain 替代有限 query 集，以随 token 数累积的 statistical signal 替代可记忆 key；回答如何兼顾输入扰动与输出修改。

evidence.section: This Work: Model Fingerprinting via Semantically Conditioned Watermarks

related_work_moves.move: credit_or_foundation：介绍 generation-time Red-Green watermark 的 private key、context、green/red split、δ 和 one-sided z-test。
nearest_neighbor_contrast + gap_creation：将 open-weight watermark 分为 distillation、weight perturbation、classifier，强调 utility、durability 与 statistical guarantees 缺口。

method_moves.move: state_problem：Sec. 3 将 query-key retrieval 的 brittle failure 与新范式的两个设计目标并置。

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism：说明 atypical key 控制 FPR、specific query 避免正常输出触发，并以 effectiveness 统一 controlled FPR、TPR、utility。

evidence.anchor: controlled FPR, high TPR and low impact on utility

method_moves.move: derive：从过滤与 exact matching 的两个失败路径推出输入域和输出信号必须分别扩展、分散。
define_component：以 semantic domain 替代有限 query；域内扰动仍可能留在触发集合。

evidence.anchor: perturbed inputs generally remain inside the domain

method_moves.move: connect_to_prediction：将 domain entropy 与 watermark signal 强度、query 数量和 targeted adversary 的域保密条件连接。

evidence.anchor: with a low-entropy domain, more queries are needed

method_moves.move: define_component：将 exact key 换成 diffused statistical signal，要求 token edit robustness、统计原则和随长度增长的 detection power。

evidence.anchor: signal that is diffused throughout the entire LLM response

method_moves.move: setup_notation：Sec. 4 输入 model θ、private key ξ、D_target、D_reg 和 Red-Green 参数，明确目标域水印与域外保持的分工。
instantiate_algorithm：Algorithm 1 冻结 θ0，逐步采样两域样本，计算两项 loss 并按 λ、η 更新 θ。
derive：Eq. (1) 用 target 上的 KL 拟合 watermarked teacher 分布；Eq. (2) 在 D_reg 惩罚相对 θ0 的正向偏离。
explain_mechanism：指出 regularizer 在分布相等时最小，并以 App. C.4 的 utility 对照支撑其组件作用。

evidence.anchor: minimized if and only if the distribution of θ is the same as θ0

method_moves.move: derive + connect_to_prediction：Eq. (3) 对去重 token 的 green ratio 做 variance-corrected Z-test，长度和 query 拼接提升检测力。
connect_to_experiment：以 Q 条域内 query、拼接回复和 α 阈值结束方法，并把 1000 queries 的完全鲁棒性钩到 Sec. 5。

claim_closure.claim: 固定 query-key fingerprint 对部署扰动脆弱。
claim_closure.method_response: Sec. 3 将失败拆为 atypical query/key filtering 与 exact-match brittleness；Sec. 4 以 domain+statistical signal 替换。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文的单一主线是：把固定 query-key fingerprint 的输入脆弱性与可过滤 key，分别改写为语义域触发和分散、可累积的 Red-Green statistical signal；Eq. (1)–(3) 把这两个替换落实为条件蒸馏、域外保持和拼接 Z-test（pp. 3–5）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留失败机理、Algorithm 1、两项训练 loss、detector、FSR 定义、三模型主 benchmark、prominent/targeted robustness 矩阵、stealth judge 和两项结论页限制（pp. 3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载超参数、攻击 prompt、额外 quality、query-count/域/δ/regularizer/leakage 消融、Theorem D.1 proof、token/multi-key/harmful 扩展、成本和定性回复（pp. 17–36）。主文可理解决策，但复核 FPR 条件、quality 代价和实际攻击实现必须读取附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的写作模式是先在 Sec. 3 将 prior failure 拆成 query 与 key 两个通道，再让 Tables 2–3 用同一 FSR 网格承接 deployment robustness，并用 Fig. 3 把「单次信号弱化—多次 query 恢复」机制可视化（pp. 3–9、21）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大缺口是强泛化措辞与证据范围不完全同层：all tested 只覆盖列示模型、攻击和预算；domain secrecy 是 stealth 前提，域内 judge quality 与 81.92M-token/$6 embedding cost 也在附录才显式量化（pp. 7–10、20、32）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 当鲁棒性来自可累积统计证据时，正文应同时展示信号如何被单次扰动削弱、为何增加独立观测可恢复检测功效，并把主攻击矩阵和该机制绑定（Sec. 4.2；Figs. 3、6）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有可定义触发域、可拼接多次输出且 null distribution 可校准的 detector；若 adversary 已知域并能阻塞全部 query，或 key/context diversity 不满足 Theorem D.1 前提，则不能把本文的 stealth/FPR 结论外推（pp. 10、28）。
